name: backcourt/wc-mnm-filter
description: Lets shoppers filter a Mix and Match container's products by category, tag or attribute.

prefix-namespaces: sh -c 'test -f bin/strauss.phar || { mkdir -p bin && curl -fL -o bin/strauss.phar https://github.com/BrianHenryIE/strauss/releases/latest/download/strauss.phar; }'

scripts-description.makepot-audit: Generate a .pot file for translation. Dry run.
scripts-description.phpcs: Analyze code against the WordPress coding standards with PHP_CodeSniffer
scripts-description.phpcb: Fix coding standards warnings/errors automatically with PHP Code Beautifier
scripts-description.prefix-namespaces: Download the latest Strauss phar (if needed) and prefix shipped Composer packages into vendor-prefixed/
